_doc: Canonical regression scene for the display-graph gate. Three displays: primary on the left, two small displays stacked on the right (touching at y=600). Source on D1; decoy on D2 (touches source y at 400 → perp_overlap = 0, not viable); target on D3 (perp_overlap = 100, viable). New aggregate model: east → 300 direct. Current code: same-display empty, graph picks D2 (larger y-overlap with D1 than D3), ranker on D2 finds nothing, returns no candidate. See fixture-catalog.md §4.
